name: The Rigger (class portrait)
paint: A quick-handed tinkerer with a Visualizer glove, a figment of flecks forming over the glove, a wrench through the belt, a crooked grin.
avoid: a stage magician · a known inventor character
prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A quick-handed tinkerer with a Visualizer glove, a figment of flecks forming over the glove, a wrench through the belt, a crooked grin.
Avoid: a stage magician · a known inventor character
CAST AND STAGING: A young 27-year-old dark-skinned man with round cheek planes, short tight curls, a small gap between front teeth and a CROOKED GRIN. Waist-up leaning slightly toward viewer-left, ONE VISUALIZER GLOVE held palm-up close to sternum with an angular incomplete FIGMENT FORM made from clearly separate flecks hovering just above palm. ONE ordinary WRENCH sits through a visible belt loop at the other hip, tool jaw and handle form one coherent piece. Rolled canvas sleeves, patched muted tan work coat, no plate armor, magician hat, cards, pose from known inventor or copied face. Workshop pegboard shadow and one open daylight window behind, natural materials preserved; no huge glowing fog. Five fingers and wrist proportion believable.
ACTING SENTENCE: A quick-handed tinkerer tests a forming figment over his glove because a repair may now work, and feels amused ingenuity.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one deep petrol-blue #075369 accent on the Visualizer glove and flecks is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
